topics.title: C++ Interview Setup
topics.summary: Build, run, and reason about C++17 interview code with a small, reliable template and explicit ownership.
outcomes: Use references, const, and RAII deliberately
Write a portable C++17 interview harness

topics.title: Complexity Analysis
topics.summary: Derive time and space bounds, amortized costs, and input-sensitive trade-offs instead of memorizing labels.
outcomes: Distinguish worst, expected, and amortized cost
Expose hidden input dimensions and space costs

topics.title: STL and Iterators
topics.summary: Choose C++ containers and algorithms by guarantees, then reason safely about iterators, comparators, and invalidation.

topics.title: Arrays and Strings
topics.summary: Solve sequence problems with explicit invariants: two pointers, windows, prefix summaries, and in-place transforms.
outcomes: Choose pointer, window, or prefix patterns

topics.title: Hash Tables
topics.summary: Key-value storage, collision handling, load factor, resizing, and interview-grade implementations.
outcomes: Implement a robust C++ hash map sketch

topics.title: Stacks and Queues
topics.summary: Recognize LIFO, FIFO, monotonic, and deque invariants in parsing, traversal, and next-element problems.
outcomes: Model work with LIFO or FIFO

topics.title: Linked Lists
topics.summary: Manipulate node chains safely using pointer invariants, sentinels, and fast/slow reasoning.
outcomes: Reverse and splice without losing nodes

topics.title: Trees and BSTs
topics.summary: Reason about hierarchical data with recursive contracts, traversal order, and BST invariants.

topics.title: Heaps and Priority Queues
topics.summary: Use partial ordering to retrieve extrema, maintain top-k sets, and schedule work efficiently.
outcomes: State build, push, and pop costs

topics.title: Graphs
topics.summary: Model relationships and apply traversal, ordering, connectivity, and shortest-path invariants.
outcomes: Select BFS, DFS, topological sort, or Dijkstra

topics.title: Recursion and Backtracking
topics.summary: Design recursive contracts and prune state-space searches without corrupting shared state.
outcomes: Define base cases and decreasing measures

topics.title: Sorting and Binary Search
topics.summary: Choose sorting guarantees and use boundary-based binary search over values or monotone predicates.

topics.title: Greedy Algorithms
topics.summary: Make local choices only when an exchange argument or invariant proves they compose globally.
outcomes: Prove rules by exchange or staying ahead
Find counterexamples and switch to DP

topics.title: Dynamic Programming
topics.summary: Turn repeated subproblems into explicit state, transitions, base cases, and evaluation order.

topics.title: Bit Manipulation
topics.summary: Use binary representations, masks, and XOR identities while avoiding signed-shift and width traps.

topics.title: Discrete Mathematics
topics.summary: Use logic, sets, counting, graphs, invariants, and proof techniques to justify interview algorithms.
outcomes: Translate conditions into logic and sets
Construct contradiction, induction, and invariant proofs

topics.title: Linear Algebra
topics.summary: Understand vectors, matrices, projections, eigenstructure, and gradients as the language of ML and quantitative models.
outcomes: Reason about rank, basis, and projections

topics.title: Probability
topics.summary: Model uncertainty with conditional probability, random variables, expectation, variance, and common distributions.
outcomes: Use expectation, variance, and distribution assumptions correctly

topics.title: Statistics
topics.summary: Estimate, test, and communicate uncertainty while separating association, prediction, and causal claims.
outcomes: Detect bias, leakage, and causal overclaiming

topics.title: SQL Fundamentals
topics.summary: Query relational data correctly with joins, aggregation, windows, transactions, and index-aware reasoning.
outcomes: Write correct joins and grouped queries
Explain transactions, constraints, and index trade-offs

topics.title: Linux and the CLI
topics.summary: Navigate Linux processes, files, permissions, pipes, signals, and diagnostics from a safe command line.
outcomes: Diagnose CPU, memory, disk, and network symptoms

topics.title: Networking Fundamentals
topics.summary: Trace traffic through DNS, transport, IP routing, TLS, and HTTP while debugging by layer.
outcomes: Compare TCP, UDP, HTTP, DNS, and TLS

topics.title: Git, Testing, and Debugging
topics.summary: Manage changes as commits, build layered tests, and debug from reproducible evidence rather than guesses.
outcomes: Explain Git objects, branches, and merges
Choose unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

topics.title: Behavioral Interview Basics
topics.summary: Turn real experience into concise, evidence-backed stories for recruiter, behavioral, project, and negotiation conversations.
outcomes: Handle recruiter and negotiation conversations accurately

topics.title: Data Cleaning
topics.summary: Turn raw records into an auditable, leakage-safe analytical table without erasing meaningful variation.
outcomes: Profile schema, missingness, duplicates, and outliers

topics.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
topics.summary: Use targeted summaries and visual reasoning to understand a dataset, test assumptions, and form falsifiable hypotheses.
outcomes: Run univariate, bivariate, and slice-based analysis
Find leakage, imbalance, drift, and collection artifacts

topics.title: Experiment Design
topics.summary: Design controlled experiments that identify causal effects, protect users, and support trustworthy product decisions.
outcomes: Define estimands, units, metrics, and guardrails
Diagnose interference, novelty, peeking, and instrumentation failures

topics.title: Feature Engineering
topics.summary: Create stable, available, and leakage-safe representations that expose useful signal to a model.
outcomes: Engineer numeric, categorical, temporal, and interaction features

topics.title: Linear Models
topics.summary: Understand least squares, regularization, diagnostics, and the conditions under which linear models remain strong baselines.
outcomes: Diagnose residual, collinearity, and extrapolation failures

topics.title: Logistic Regression
topics.summary: Model class log-odds, interpret conditional effects, regularize safely, and connect scores to calibrated decisions.
outcomes: Separate probability estimation from threshold policy

topics.title: Tree Ensembles
topics.summary: Compare trees, random forests, and gradient boosting through their split logic, bias-variance behavior, and production trade-offs.
outcomes: Interpret features without trusting biased importance blindly

topics.title: Unsupervised Learning
topics.summary: Use clustering and dimensionality reduction as exploratory models whose value depends on geometry and downstream validation.
outcomes: Validate stability and downstream usefulness without ground-truth labels

topics.title: Model Evaluation
topics.summary: Select metrics, design validation, diagnose leakage, and make model choices that survive production.

topics.title: Optimization for ML
topics.summary: Reason about objectives, gradients, conditioning, stochastic updates, and the optimization path that turns parameters into a fitted model.
outcomes: Distinguish optimization error from generalization error

topics.title: Neural Network Foundations
topics.summary: Build and debug multilayer networks through computation graphs, backpropagation, initialization, regularization, and training dynamics.
outcomes: Choose activations, initialization, normalization, and losses
Diagnose vanishing, exploding, and overfitting behavior

topics.title: CNNs
topics.summary: Understand convolutional inductive bias, receptive fields, residual networks, and efficient vision-model debugging.
outcomes: Compute convolution shapes and receptive fields
Explain equivariance, pooling, and residual blocks
Design leakage-safe image training and evaluation

topics.title: Sequence Models
topics.summary: Model ordered data with recurrence, gating, masking, teacher forcing, and sequence-aware evaluation.
outcomes: Explain RNN, LSTM, and GRU state updates
Handle variable lengths and causal masking
Diagnose long-range dependency and train/inference mismatch

topics.title: Transformers
topics.summary: Derive attention, positional information, masking, architecture families, and the memory/compute trade-offs of transformer models.
outcomes: Compute scaled dot-product attention and shapes
Compare encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder models
Reason about context length, KV cache, and quadratic cost

topics.title: Natural Language Processing
topics.summary: Model language through tokenization, representations, task formulation, decoding, and evaluation beyond surface overlap.
outcomes: Compare tokenization and NLP task formulations
Choose encoder, decoder, or encoder-decoder architectures
Evaluate language systems for meaning, safety, and distribution shift

topics.title: Computer Vision
topics.summary: Frame image classification, detection, and segmentation systems from labeling geometry through deployment shift.
outcomes: Distinguish core vision task outputs and metrics
Diagnose shortcut learning and acquisition shift

topics.title: Recommender Systems
topics.summary: Design retrieval, ranking, and feedback systems that balance relevance, discovery, constraints, and long-term marketplace health.
outcomes: Explain collaborative, content, retrieval, and ranking approaches
Handle implicit feedback and cold start
Evaluate offline, online, and long-term ecosystem effects

topics.title: Forecasting
topics.summary: Forecast time-indexed outcomes with honest backtests, lag-aware features, uncertainty, hierarchy, and production monitoring.
outcomes: Decompose level, trend, seasonality, and residuals

topics.title: Embeddings
topics.summary: Use dense vector representations for semantic similarity while respecting geometry, domain shift, and evaluation limits.
outcomes: Evaluate embedding quality on a real retrieval or clustering task

topics.title: Vector Search
topics.summary: Design exact and approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval with measurable recall, latency, memory, filtering, and update behavior.
outcomes: Compare flat, HNSW, IVF, and product-quantized indexes
Handle metadata filters, deletes, sharding, and embedding migration

topics.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
topics.summary: Build RAG systems that retrieve authoritative evidence, compose grounded context, cite sources, and fail safely when support is absent.
outcomes: Design ingestion, chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and generation
Evaluate retrieval separately from answer quality
Control freshness, permissions, prompt injection, and citation fidelity

topics.title: Fine-Tuning
topics.summary: Choose when and how to adapt pretrained models with supervised examples, parameter-efficient methods, preference signals, and rigorous baselines.
outcomes: Distinguish prompting, retrieval, supervised tuning, and preference optimization
Reason about LoRA, catastrophic forgetting, cost, and deployment

topics.title: Agents and Tool Use
topics.summary: Design bounded agent loops that select tools, validate arguments, preserve state, obtain approval, and terminate safely.
outcomes: Design typed tool boundaries and state
Control permissions, side effects, prompt injection, and runaway execution

topics.title: LLM Evaluation
topics.summary: Evaluate generative systems with task rubrics, deterministic checks, calibrated judges, safety probes, and production experiments.
outcomes: Combine deterministic, model-graded, and human judgments
Measure quality, safety, latency, cost, and regressions

topics.title: Responsible AI
topics.summary: Translate AI risks into scoped harms, data and model controls, human oversight, documentation, monitoring, and accountable decisions.
outcomes: Identify affected parties and plausible harms
Measure fairness and safety with contextual limits
Design governance, documentation, appeal, and monitoring controls

topics.title: MLOps and ML System Design
topics.summary: Design reproducible ML platforms spanning data, training, registry, deployment, feature serving, observability, governance, and recovery.
outcomes: Design batch, online, and streaming inference paths
Define release, monitoring, rollback, lineage, and cost controls
